question.text: On the expiry day of Commodity Index Futures, the Final Settlement Price (FSP) is based on:

answer.text: Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP) of constituents' futures during 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM
Closing price of the index at 3:30 PM
Opening price of the index on the expiry day
Average of high and low prices during the entire trading session

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook p.169, the FSP is based on the volume weighted average traded price of the constituents' futures contracts during 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM on the expiry date. The Trap: Not the 3:30 PM closing price (equity market timing). Not the opening price or full-session average; the specific 4:00-5:00 PM VWAP window is the workbook-stated method. Note: The 4:00-5:00 PM window applies on the expiry date for commodity index futures FSP determination.
